caption: A 1280-byte IPv6 packet split into 13 frames of 102 usable bytes. Twelve frames carry 102 bytes each (1224 bytes) and the last frame carries the remaining 56 bytes, so ceil(1280 ÷ 102) = 13 fragments.

spec.title: 127 − 25 = 102 B usable per frame
spec.aria: An array of 13 fragments: twelve full fragments of 102 bytes and one final fragment of 56 bytes, made by splitting a 1280-byte IPv6 packet.
